questions.title: How can I get started?
questions.subtitle: Find out how you can quickly and easily get started with our platform. Here you will find the most important steps for your introduction.

list.question: How do I register on the platform?
list.answer: You can simply register with your email address and get immediate access to all features.

list.question: How do I set up my interests and filters?
list.answer: In the dashboard, you can individually adjust your interests and filters to see only relevant tenders.

list.question: How do I receive notifications?
list.answer: You will receive notifications by email or directly in the dashboard as soon as new suitable projects are available.

email.title: Simply enter your email address
email.subtitle: Our team will get back to you as soon as possible and will be happy to assist you with any concerns.
